ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Full Extent of Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: An investigation into the scope and scale of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the Feeding Our Future scheme and other potential schemes
questions: What is the full extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How many schemes are currently operating in the state?
ideas.insight: I believe that a thorough investigation into Medicaid fraud in Minnesota could uncover a significant pattern of abuse and neglect, and that data analysis and public records could be key to uncovering the full extent of the problem.
